articles.title: How to recognise a phishing attempt
articles.heading: How to recognise a phishing attempt

sections.heading: What to know
paragraphs: Be cautious of urgency, unfamiliar links and requests for security codes.
Open your bank through a known bookmark or its official app. Verify unexpected contact using a trusted channel.
callouts: Never disclose passwords, PINs or one-time security codes.

articles.title: What to do if your card is lost
articles.heading: What to do if your card is lost

sections.heading: What to know
paragraphs: Act promptly when a card is missing or you notice unfamiliar activity.
Contact your card issuer through a trusted channel and follow its instructions for blocking the card. Review recent activity.
callouts: This public demo cannot freeze a real card or report a loss.

sections.heading: What to know
paragraphs: A card authorisation may reserve funds before the merchant completes settlement.
A pending debit can reduce available funds while the booked balance remains unchanged. Release and settlement timing depends on the issuer and merchant.
callouts: Do not assume a pending payment has failed or repeat it automatically.

sections.heading: What to know
paragraphs: Transfers move funds using recipient and account details.
Check the recipient, currency and amount before confirming. Settlement time depends on the payment route and processing schedule.
callouts: This article does not execute or guarantee a transfer.

sections.heading: What to know
paragraphs: Incorrect recipient details, restrictions or insufficient available funds can prevent a transfer.
Review the reported reason and payment status before attempting another transfer. Use a trusted support channel if the outcome is unclear.
callouts: Avoid duplicate payments when an earlier result is uncertain.

sections.heading: What to know
paragraphs: Balance records booked funds; available balance reflects funds currently usable.
For the demo current account, pending debit holds reduce available balance. Other banking products may use different rules.
callouts: Pending amounts are not always booked transactions.

sections.heading: What to know
paragraphs: A recurring arrangement describes future scheduled collections or payments.
Review the schedule, amount and beneficiary. Stopping an arrangement may not cancel a payment already in progress.
callouts: Contact the service provider about any separate contract.

sections.heading: What to know
paragraphs: Some sensitive actions require stronger verification than the initial sign-in.
An authorisation should be tied to the particular action and expire after a short period. Verify the action details before approving it.
callouts: Never share a verification code with someone who contacts you.

sections.heading: What to know
paragraphs: Risk depends on market exposure, liquidity, credit quality and your investment horizon.
A risk label summarises selected characteristics. It cannot predict losses or guarantee that a product is suitable for you.
callouts: Investments can lose value. This is general education, not personal advice.

sections.heading: What to know
paragraphs: Start with income, essential costs and a manageable savings target.
Review spending categories regularly and leave room for irregular costs. Use estimates as a starting point and adjust them as circumstances change.
callouts: A budget is a planning aid, not a promise about future finances.

sections.heading: What to know
paragraphs: Bond values respond to interest rates, issuer credit quality and liquidity.
A longer maturity can increase interest-rate sensitivity. A higher quoted yield may reflect greater risk.
callouts: Bonds and bond funds can lose capital.

sections.heading: What to know
paragraphs: An exchange rate expresses one currency in units of another.
Compare the quoted rate, markup and any fixed fee. An indicative rate may differ from the final executable quote.
callouts: All rates on this website are illustrative demo values.

sections.heading: What to know
paragraphs: Use trusted devices and keep browser and operating system updates current.
Sign out on shared devices and verify the site address before entering credentials. Avoid entering real credentials into a demo.
callouts: A public product guide never needs your banking password.

sections.heading: What to know
paragraphs: A statement summarises booked activity during a stated period.
Check opening and closing balances, transaction dates and fees. Report unfamiliar entries through a trusted support channel.
callouts: Pending authorisations may not appear as booked statement entries.

sections.heading: What to know
paragraphs: Use contact details from your verified bank app or official documentation.
Avoid numbers provided in suspicious messages. Ask your provider about accessible formats and communication options.
callouts: Aster is a demo and has no real customer contact centre.
